title: Times Union: Nearly 300 years later, Albany’s Van Ostrande-Radliff House begins a new chapter

# Times Union: Nearly 300 years later, Albany’s Van Ostrande-Radliff House begins a new chapter


*10.6.26*


**


"It has survived floods and fires, supported many local businesses and now, after nearly three centuries, the Van Ostrande-Radliff House has entered a new chapter.


Historic Albany Foundation unveiled its newly restored headquarters under sunny skies Tuesday at 48 Hudson Ave., giving the public, stakeholders and local dignitaries a first look at the 1728 structure and its new role as a center for preservation and education.


...Schuyler Bull, a member of the HAF Board of directors and vice president/director of Marketing & Communications for Pioneer, said visitors aren’t stepping into a modern recreation of Albany’s past when they enter the house; they’re experiencing a piece of the city’s history that has survived intact."


[Read the full story covered by Shannon Fromma in the Times Union here.](https://www.timesunion.com/realestate/article/van-ostrande-radliff-house-albany-reopens-22464447.php)
